expression_source: METABRIC Illumina microarray mRNA z-scores (diploid-reference samples), cBioPortal
methodology: Per training set / CV fold: median-impute, winsorise (train percentiles 1/99) and standardise every gene with training statistics only; rank genes by |univariate Cox score z| on the training rows only; keep the top-k; fit Elastic-Net Cox along an alpha path. k, l1_ratio and alpha are chosen by train-only CV (screening repeated inside every fold). No variance filter (z-score genes have ~equal variance). Test rows are used only for the final metrics.

expression_provenance.duplicate_rule: first row in file order kept per Entrez ID; no averaging; uses no data values

hyperparameters.selected_by: train-only CV (screening repeated inside each fold)
